Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in human assays against the target pyruvate kinase PKM (CHEMBL1075189). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary to match the target CHEMBL ID. Filter assays where assay_organism is 'Homo sapiens'. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Return columns named compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
